source_identity.kind: original synthetic agent-authored rule specifications and hand-selected structured cases, with Python CPU rendering and truth calculation
source_identity.identity_basis: Actual PI_PROVIDER and PI_MODEL environment values exposed to this session; aliases only.
source_identity.unknowns: Immutable model revision, sampling temperature, token usage, and original provider training-data provenance are not exposed.

generation_settings.authoring: Existing agent text generation only. Rule statements, case facts and two independent executable algorithms were authored by the same agent session.
generation_settings.execution: Local standard-library Python CPU only; no network, model loading, inference jobs, APIs, or separately billed generation.
generation_settings.randomness: None; explicitly curated cases, fixed ordering, SHA-256-derived opaque option IDs.
generation_settings.target_rotation: Independent deterministic round-robin counters per split and option count. At most one count difference between populated target positions for a given split/choice count.
generation_settings.do_not_rerun_in_published_directory: Published shards are frozen; copy generator and frozen assignment to a new owned version directory to regenerate.

data:pilot-v1:rule_application:g03.mechanism: ordered greedy capacity admission with skip-and-continue

data:pilot-v1:rule_application:g04.mechanism: modular cyclic indexing with signed displacement

data:pilot-v1:rule_application:g05.mechanism: signed weighted sum and score classification

data:pilot-v1:rule_application:g12.mechanism: Condorcet winner from strict pairwise ballot majorities

split_policy: Ten rows per mechanism. All related cases and renderings stay in the preallocated split. Validation holds out complete graph-reachability and pairwise-election mechanisms, not renamed numeric thresholds.

label_strategy.generation_implementation: generate.py computes rule results and creates meaningful choice text, then rotates the target position.
label_strategy.audit_implementation: audit.py does not import generate.py. It reconstructs expected answer text from audit_cases.jsonl with separately implemented semantics, locates exactly one matching supplied choice, then compares its opaque ID with target_id.

algorithm_separation_examples.fees: per-hour summation vs closed band formula
algorithm_separation_examples.graph: frontier traversal vs all-pairs transitive closure
algorithm_separation_examples.ballots: candidate rank comparisons vs accumulated pairwise matrix
algorithm_separation_examples.checksum: weighted sum modulo vs repeated bounded modular additions

label_strategy.scope_limit: Executable checking is genuine but not independent authorship. The same teacher created the rule semantics, structured facts and verifier. No claim of independent natural-language correctness or independent teacher corroboration.

text_spot_review.selection: r01 and r10 of each of g01 through g12
text_spot_review.method: Same agent read rendered state, question, all choices and marked target; checked alignment with explicit policy, boundaries, mutually exclusive result descriptions.
text_spot_review.finding: No ambiguity or target mismatch found in inspected rows. This is self-review, not independent correctness evidence.

review.outcome_balance: Routing 2/3/3/2; score decisions 3 reject/3 hold/4 release; controller 3 locked/4 open/3 occupied; election 5 elected/5 nobody. Other mechanisms use multiple exact numeric/set/destination results; see full outcome counts in validation_report.json.

usage_and_license.origin: Original synthetic usage constraints: generated via existing approved provider access, with no external dataset or private real data.
usage_and_license.terms: Use remains subject to the applicable existing provider/account terms and project permissions. No separately asserted redistribution license; no claim of public-domain, CC0, or independently cleared blanket redistribution rights.
usage_and_license.existing_access_cost: Existing session access; not separately metered here. £0 additional and £0 pending spend.

limitations: Only 12 generator groups, including two held-out validation mechanisms with 10 dependent cases each. Effective independent validation diversity is approximately two mechanisms, not 20 unrelated tasks.
Graph reachability and Condorcet pairwise majority are completely held-out mechanisms, but generic language, arithmetic and set concepts are necessarily shared across groups.
Within-group text is template-based. Explicit parameters, policies, inputs, edge cases and target outcomes vary; this is not broad linguistic or real-world coverage.
All examples use deliberately explicit, small, unambiguous fictional policies; no missing-data or adversarial ambiguity coverage.
Some distractors are easier than others, and tiny 2-, 3- and 5-choice subsets cannot cover all target positions.
Structured facts are audited, not independently parsed from natural language. A shared specification or rendering mistake could survive both algorithms.
Opaque IDs and all audit/provenance/label metadata must stay out of model inputs.
No final data or evaluation artifacts were accessed. No passage_entailment generated.
